AI agents are getting more powerful  but who controls their power?

When an AI can read emails, access files and call APIs, a hidden prompt injection can become more than just a bad answer.

Capability ≠ Authorization.

Least privilege, human approval and monitoring aren't optional details — they're part of the security boundary. 

What should an AI agent never be allowed to do automatically?

#Cybersecurity #AISecurity #AIAgents #InfoSec
